AgentRef.title: Agent Reference
AgentRef.description: Reference to an agent, resolved at runtime. Exactly one of 'name', 'registry', or 'path' must be specified.

oneOf.title: Named agent
oneOf.description: Agent looked up by name in project-local agents/ or user library ~/.config/armadai/agents/.

oneOf.title: Registry agent
oneOf.description: Agent read from the local registry cache (~/.config/armadai/registry/). The command that filled this cache (armadai registry) was removed; only an existing cache is read.

registry.description: Registry identifier (e.g. 'official/security'), resolved as a file in the local registry cache.

oneOf.title: Path agent
oneOf.description: Agent referenced by a direct file path (absolute or relative to project root).

path.description: Path to the agent Markdown file.

PromptRef.description: Reference to a composable prompt fragment. Exactly one of 'name' or 'path' must be specified.

oneOf.title: Named prompt
oneOf.description: Prompt looked up by name in project-local prompts/ or user library ~/.config/armadai/prompts/.

oneOf.title: Path prompt

path.description: Path to the prompt Markdown file.

oneOf.title: Named skill
oneOf.description: Skill looked up by name in project-local skills/ or user library ~/.config/armadai/skills/.

oneOf.title: Path skill
oneOf.description: Skill referenced by a direct path (absolute or relative to project root).

LinkConfig.title: Linker Configuration
LinkConfig.description: Configuration for generating native config files for AI CLI tools.

target.title: Link target
target.description: Target AI CLI tool to generate configuration for.

coordinator.title: Coordinator agent
coordinator.description: Name of the agent whose prompt is written into the target's root instructions file (e.g. .claude/CLAUDE.md). Matched against the agent's title slug.

output.title: Output directory
output.description: Custom output directory for the generated config files.

ProjectDefaults.title: Project Defaults
ProjectDefaults.description: Default settings applied to all agents in the project.

mode.description: Default interaction mode. 'guided' makes agents ask clarifying questions before responding.

OrchestrationConfig.title: Orchestration Configuration
OrchestrationConfig.description: Declared delegation topology; nothing executes any pattern. armadai validate checks that its names are declared agents. With enabled: true and pattern: hierarchical, armadai link checks its structure before writing (coordinator present, at least one team, no duplicates, coordinator not in a team); with another pattern link skips that check, and a team-level pattern under a non-hierarchical root makes link fail. The Claude Code policy gate enforces it when policy is strict. The engine limits (max_*, timeout, consensus_threshold, token_budget, cost_limit, routes) are parsed but no longer used.

enabled.description: With pattern: hierarchical, makes armadai link check the block's structure before writing. Without it, link checks nothing.

policy.description: Claude Code policy gate: strict refuses any delegation the declared topology does not allow.

pattern.description: Nothing executes it. hierarchical (with enabled: true) turns on armadai link's structure check; any other value skips it.

free_agents.description: Assistance agents reachable from anywhere under policy: strict (e.g. Explore, Plan).

ShellConfig.title: Shell Configuration
ShellConfig.description: Settings of the removed armadai shell. Still accepted, ignored.

default_provider.description: Default CLI tool of the removed shell. Ignored.

default_model.description: Default model tier (latest:fast, latest:pro, latest:max) or concrete model name.

max_history.description: Max conversation turns to keep in prompt context.

tandem.description: Providers of the removed shell tandem mode. Ignored.

ShellProviderEntry.description: An entry for shell tandem/pipeline — either a provider (direct CLI) or an agent (from the project's agents: list).

provider.description: CLI tool name used by the removed shell. Ignored.

model.description: Model tier (latest:fast/pro/max) or concrete model name. Ignored when agent: is set.

agent.description: Agent name (from the project's agents: list). When set, loads the agent's system prompt and uses its metadata provider/model.

ShellPipelineConfig.description: Pipeline configuration with named, ordered steps.

PipelineStep.description: A single pipeline step with a name, role prompt, and providers.

prompt.description: Role prompt describing what this step does.
